reuse.why: Keeps using NO_SAVED_TEMPLATES and getFixedCategoryIds, but there is no shared category selection to reuse and the change does not create one, so the hidden rule is edited in six places.

duplication.why: The same includeHiddenCategories conditional SQL fragment is pasted into five near-identical queries plus a sixth in-loop variant in copyPreviousMonth, extending the existing copy-paste.

placement.why: The flag is handled in the month-wide budget actions in budget/actions.ts, where those exclusions already live.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions' signatures and hidden filters change.

maintainability.why: Interpolating the same optional SQL clause into five copied queries and a separate JS check leaves the hidden-category rule with six definitions that must be kept in sync.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared month-wide category selection exists in the tree; the change edits each copy directly.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated conditional is copied verbatim into each action, not disguised.
